paragraphs.text: Iizuka (ee-EE-zoo-kah) , the Ruthless , was a Human Samurai of Kamigawa during the time of the Kami War .

Iizuka was a landless ronin and the former captain of the guard to Lord Kensai. He had one good eye and one eye that could channel blood magic to see a man's soul. He led a band of veterans including his son, whom he killed during a heist-gone-wrong.
